role: Untouched holdout reserved outside the LLVM development questions

stages.task: Trace borrowing versus owned JSON string deserialization, including escaped text, invalid UTF-8, and from_str/from_slice entry points. Distinguish observations, invariants and execution evidence.

Trace StreamDeserializer byte_offset and EOF/error behavior for complete values, partial final input and malformed following input. Identify which saved observations apply and which new evidence is required.
Audit RawValue validation and serialization versus ordinary Value/string paths. Include feature gates, invalid raw input and public API callers; distinguish certified reuse from recommendations.

ordering: Finish the generic runtime using development data and freeze its full source/executable/embedding/prompt/harness hashes.

Prepare the holdout source, executable test environment and seed independently of candidate delivery. Freeze prompts, source fingerprints, question-level required original evidence and applicability oracle before any hook body is observed.
Execute one predeclared holdout evaluation campaign. No threshold/range selection or oracle changes are allowed after observing a body.
Report every outcome, including absent-in-DB evidence, delivery omissions, invalid certification, recommendation-only answer errors, actual tests and inclusive token use.
failurePolicy: If holdout feedback changes the algorithm, this set becomes development data. Do not retune on it and call a later run an untouched holdout.
scopeLimit: Reserving a repository and task descriptions is not freezing the full oracle, producing an unseen-source result, or satisfying the paper experiment.
